name: text-relay
description: A temporary, private text relay built for Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/html.js && node --input-type=module -e "import('./src/html.js').then(({renderPage}) => renderPage().split('<script>').slice(1).map((part) => part.split('</script>')[0]).forEach((script) => new Function(script)));"
